translated_text:
Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Melawi Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as the Element of Regional Government Administration that leads the Implementation of Government Affairs that are the Authority of the Autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Melawi.
4. Regional Secretary is the Regional Secretary of Melawi Regency. 5. Regional Apparatus is the element assisting the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region. 6. Women are human beings of female gender starting from infants, adolescents, adults to the elderly.
7. Women with Disabilities are women who have self-limitations, which can be physical, cognitive, mental, sensory, emotional, developmental or some combination of these.
8. Elderly Women are women who have reached 60 years of age and above.
9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social and psychological to the victim.
10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Victim... women who experience misery and/or
11. Victim is a woman suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence and life vulnerability. intended to .. is all activities that AJ
12. Protection of Women is carried out by regional government, society, to provide a sense of security that is carried out by PS ,de will or has and/or other parties who know or hear of violence against women occurring. 1k a possibly ah . ct that is carried out as soon as
13. Service/handling is tin an tah ak to the victim when seeing, hearing and/or knowing vu1 ' During or after the occurrence of violence against the victim.
1 b who have
14. Companion is a person or representative and em aga who has expertise in providing assistance to victims to conduct counseling/therapy and/or advocacy. dalah tu 15. Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, a sua institution or functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence.
16. Safe House is a residence for victims during the assistance process for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers.
17. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing 5 (five) types of services for women and children victims of violence, namely (1) Complaint Handling (2) Health Services (3) Social Rehabilitation (4) Law Enforcement and Legal Aid, and (5) Repatriation and Social Reintegration.
18. Complaint Handling is a series of actions taken by the integrated service provider to follow up on Reports of acts of violence against women submitted by victims, families and the community.
19. Health Services are efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
20. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out their social functions properly.
21. Law Enforcement is the action of officials given authority by the state to implement statutory regulations. 22. Legal Aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocacy to provide assistance to witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
23. Repatriation is an effort to return female victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
24. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment for victims.
25. Integrated Service Unit or abbreviated as UPT is a unified unit that organizes integrated service functions for women victims of violence.
26. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward.
27. Household... ct who have 27 R household is husband, wife an an , people . h family relationship due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care and guardianship and/or domestic workers who reside in the household.

heading: Article 5
Article 6
text:
Pasal 6

Selain upaya pencegahan yang dilakukan oleh Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5, upaya pencegahan juga dilakukan oleh keluarga dan/ atau kerabat terdekat, masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan dan Lembaga adat.
translated_text:
Article 6

In addition to prevention efforts carried out by the Regional Government as referred to in Article 5, prevention efforts are also carried out by families and/or closest relatives, communities, educational institutions and Customary Institutions.

heading: Article 7
text:
Pasal 7

(1) Penyelenggaraan Pelayanan/Penanganan terhadap korban dilakukan secara terpadu oleh PPT.

(2) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat menerima dan mengirim rujukan kasus dari dan/ atau kepada unit pelayanan lainnya secara berjejaring.

(3) Ketentuan Lebih lanjut mengenai pengembangan, mekanisme, dan hubungan kerja jejaring PPT yang terintegrasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 7

(1) The Implementation of Service/Handling for victims is carried out in an integrated manner by PPT.

(2) PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) may receive and send case referrals from and/or to other service units in a networked manner.

(3) Further provisions regarding the development, mechanism, and working relationships of the integrated PPT network as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: Article 14
Article 15
text:
Pasal 15

Kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf a meliputi perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit, luka, cidera atau cacat pada tubuh, gugurnya kandungan, pingsan, dan/ atau kematian.
translated_text:
Article 15

Physical violence as referred to in Article 14 letter a includes acts that result in pain, wounds, injury or disability to the body, miscarriage, unconsciousness, and/or death.

heading: Article 16
text:
Pasal 16

Kekerasan psikis sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf b meliputi perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya, dan/atau penderitaan psikis berat.
translated_text:
Article 16

Psychological violence as referred to in Article 14 letter b includes acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness, and/or severe psychological suffering.

heading: Article 18

heading: Article 19
text:
Pasal 19

Eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf e meliputi: a. tindakan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual perempuan dengan maksud untuk menguntungkan diri sendiri atau orang lain. b. tindakan atau dengan tanpa persetujuan korban yang meliputi tetapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktik serupa, penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi, atau secara melawan hukum memindahkan atau mentransplantasi organ dan/ atau jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan baik materil maupun immaterial.

c. segala bentuk pemanfaatan organ tubuh seksual atau organ tubuh lain dari korban untuk mendapatkan keuntungan, termasuk tetapi tidak terbatas pada semua kegiatan pelacuran atau pencabulan.
translated_text:
Article 19

Exploitation as referred to in Article 14 letter e includes: a. acts that exploit women economically or sexually with the intention to benefit oneself or others. b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.

c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all prostitution or indecency activities.

heading: Article 20
text:
Pasal 20

Kekerasan lainnya sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf f meliputi: a. setiap perbuatan secara melawan hukum berupa ucapan, tulisan, gambar, symbol, atau gerakan tubuh, baik dengan atau tanpa menggunakan sarana yang menimbulkan rasa takut atau mengekang kebebasan hakiki seseorang.

b. suatu keadaan dimana seseorang/korban disuruh melakukan sesuatu sedemikian rupa sehingga orang itu melakukan sesuatu berlawanan dengan kehendak sendiri.
translated_text:
Article 20

Other violence as referred to in Article 14 letter f includes: a. any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, either with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

b. a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

heading: Part One

Pemerintah Daerah
translated_text:
Part One

Regional Government

heading: Article 22
text:
Pasal 22

(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban melaksanakan dan memberikan dan bertanggung jawab dalam upaya perlindungan terhadap perempuan korban kekerasan dalam bentuk:

a. membentuk PPT;
b. perumusan kebijakan; . c. menyusun perencanaan dan melaksanakan program dan kegiatan; d. memberikan dukungan sarana dan prasarana; dan
e. mengawasi penyelenggaraan pelayanan terhadap korban dengan standar pelayanan minimal.
(2) Dalam hal pelaksanaan kewajiban dan tanggung jawab Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), Pemerintah daerah menyusun Rencana Aksi Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan.
(3) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) diatur dengan Peraturan Gubemur.
translated_text:
Article 22

(1) The Regional Government is obliged to implement and provide and is responsible for efforts to protect women victims of violence in the form of:

a. establishing an ICS;
b. policy formulation; . c. preparing planning and implementing programs and activities; d. providing facilities and infrastructure support; and
e. supervising the provision of services to victims with minimum service standards.
(2) In implementing the obligations and responsibilities of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government shall prepare a Regional Action Plan for the Protection of Women.
(3) Further provisions regarding the Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Governor Regulation.

heading: Article 23
text:
Pasal 23

Kewajiban dan tanggung jawab Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 22 ayat (1) dikoordinasikan oleh SKPD yang membidangi masalah pemberdayaan perempuan.
translated_text:
Article 23

The obligations and responsibilities of the Regional Government as referred to in Article 22 paragraph (1) shall be coordinated by the RGWU that handles women's empowerment issues.

heading: Article 25
text:
Pasal 25

(1) Upaya menyediakan dan menyelenggarakan Layanan/penanganan bagi korban dilakukan secara berjejaring.

(2) Jejaring sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) bertujuan untuk: a. mengkoordinasikan dan mensinkronisasi penanganan pelayanan PPT; b. mengembangkan jejaring serta system rujukan; dan

c. mengumpulkan, menyusun dan menyajikan laporan kekerasan. (3) Jejaring sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) melaksanakan tugas dan fungsinya sesuai dengan bentuk pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8.
translated_text:
Article 25

(1) Efforts to provide and organize services/handling for victims shall be conducted in a networked manner.

(2) The network as referred to in paragraph (1) aims to: a. coordinate and synchronize ICS service handling; b. develop networks and referral systems; and

c. collect, compile and present reports on violence. (3) The network as referred to in paragraph (2) shall carry out its duties and functions in accordance with the forms of service as referred to in Article 8.

heading: CHAPTER VII
text:
BAB VII

PUSAT PELAYANAN TERPADU
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII

INTEGRATED SERVICE CENTER

heading: Article 26
text:
Pasal 26

(1) PPT dapat dibentuk oleh instansi vertikal di daerah pemerintah Daerah, pemerintah kabupaten/kota, dan/atau Lembaga masyarakat. (2) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) terdiri dari unsur Kepolisian Daerah, SKPD yang membidangi Kesehatan, Pendidikan, Sosial, Pemberdayaan Masyarakat, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak serta Lembaga Sosial Masyarakat, yang fungsi memberikan perlindungan kepada perempuan dari tindak kekerasan yang dilakukan secara berjejaring.

(3) pelayanan dan perlindungan sementara berupa rumah aman (shelter) bagi korban.

(4) Dalam hal PPT tidak memiliki rumah aman sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (3), maka korban dirujuk pada PPT yang memiliki rumah aman. (5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Struktur Organisasi PPT diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 26

(1) An ICS may be established by vertical agencies in the Regional Government, district/city governments, and/or community institutions. (2) The ICS as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of elements of the Regional Police, RGWU that handle Health, Education, Social Affairs, Community Empowerment, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection as well as Community Social Institutions, which function to provide protection to women from acts of violence conducted in a networked manner.

(3) services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house (shelter) for victims.

(4) In the event that the ICS does not have a safe house as referred to in paragraph (3), then the victim shall be referred to an ICS that has a safe house. (5) Further provisions regarding the ICS Organizational Structure shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
text:
BAB VIII

translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

heading: Article 27
text:
Pasal 27

(1) SKPD yang membidangi Pemberdayaan Perempuan melaksanakan system informasi dan menyampaikan Laporan pelaksanaan perlindungan perempuan kepada Bupati.

(2) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai sistem informasi dan pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 27

(1) The RGWU that handles Women's Empowerment shall implement an information system and submit a Report on the implementation of women's protection to the Regent.

(2) Further provisions regarding the information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: Article 29
text:
Pasal 29

( 1) Masyarakat berperan serta dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan

a. membentuk mitra keluarga ditingkat elur masyarakat; dalam organisasi b. membentuk unit perlindungan perempuan kemasyarakatan; . .

c. melakukan sosialisai hak perempuan secara mandiri,

d. melakukan upaya pencegahan jika menemukan indikasi kekerasan terhadap perempuan di masyarakat;

e. melakukan pertolongan pertama pada korban; dan

f. melaporkan kepada instansi yang berwenang apabila dilingkungannya terjadi kekerasan terhadap perempuan.

(3) Peran serta masyarakat sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan oleh perorangan lembaga sosial kemasyarakatan, lembaga swadaya masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, swasta, dan/ atau media massa.
translated_text:
Article 29

( 1) The community participates in the implementation of protection

a. establishing family partners at the elur community level; within organizations b. establishing women's protection units in community organizations; . .

c. conducting independent socialization of women's rights,

d. undertaking preventive measures when finding indications of violence against women in the community;

e. providing first aid to victims; and

f. reporting to the competent authority if violence against women occurs in their environment.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and/or mass media.

TENTANG

PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DARI TINDAK KEKERASAN

Tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan merupakan pelanggaran hak asazi manusia sehingga, perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa diskriminasi.

Dalam rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi kekerasan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten Melawi agar terhindar dari kekerasan, ancanaman kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dibentuk peraturan daerah perlindungan perempuan.

Perlindungan perempuan merupakan segala upaya yang ditujukan untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten dan sitematis.

Peraturan perundang-undangan yang ada atau yang terkait dengan mengenai perlindungan perempuan korban kekerasan belum mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan di daerah, sehingga diperlukan dukungan kelembagaan dan peraturan di tingkat daerah yang dapat menjamin pelaksanaannya.

Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan kh ususnya dalam bentuk pencegahan, pelayanan/penanganan, dan pemberdayaan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten M 1 . e.aw1.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF MELAWI REGENCY

NUMBER 15 OF 2017

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S PROTECTION FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Acts of violence against women constitute a violation of human rights, therefore, their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women in Melawi Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades the dignity and honor of humanity, it is necessary to establish a regional regulation on women's protection.

Women's protection is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention.

The existing laws and regulations or those related to the protection of women victims of violence have not yet regulated the efforts to protect women in the regions, so institutional and regulatory support at the regional level is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts to protect women especially in the form of prevention, service/handling, and empowerment of women in Melawi Regency.

Number 19 . What is meant by efforts from the Promotive aspect is an effort to promote/socialize acts of violence to the community, with the aim of increasing public awareness and sensitivity to the danger of violence threatening women.

What is meant by efforts from the Preventive aspect is an effort that prioritizes the aspect of prevention with targets of communities vulnerable to becoming victims of violence and receiving its impacts. Preventive efforts can be carried out through community empowerment in the form of training activities and others.

What is meant by efforts from the Curative aspect is efforts made in the form of handling victims of violence who need handling according to their needs, namely handling health rehabilitation if the victim suffers the impact of violence physically or psychologically, providing assistance and law enforcement for victims who need assistance and law enforcement and so on.

What is meant by the Rehabilitative aspect is efforts made to restore victims of violence both physically, psychologically and psychosocially.
